cards.task: First call observe. Then use the shell tool to run exactly: cua tab goto https://example.com — then call pagetext to read the page. Then call done reporting the page main heading.
cards.title: Navigate + extract page text

cards.task: Use the shell tool to run: cua tab goto file://{FIXTURES}/spa.html — then call pagetext, then use mouse_agent to click the button labeled Advance, then call pagetext again, then call done reporting the new state text.
cards.title: Click through an SPA state change (receipt path)

cards.task: Use the shell tool to run: cua tab goto file://{FIXTURES}/form.html — then fill the Name field with the text Bench User, attach the file {FIXTURES}/spa.html to the File field, click Send, read the echo line with pagetext, and call done reporting the echo text.
cards.title: Form fill incl. file upload via receipt path

cards.task: Use win_agent focus_verify to see the desktop. Then use shell to launch: gnome-text-editor /tmp/cu-bench-note.txt — then win_agent focus on the editor, then kbd_agent type_verify with text BENCH-N1-OK, then kbd_agent keys Ctrl+S, then shell to run: cat /tmp/cu-bench-note.txt — then call done reporting the file content.
cards.title: Open editor, type, save, readback

cards.task: A dialog titled BenchDialog is on screen. Call observe to read it, then dismiss it by clicking its OK button with mouse_agent, then call done reporting the dialog text you read.
cards.title: Dialog handling: trigger, read, dismiss a modal

cards.task: Use shell to launch: gnome-text-editor /tmp/cu-bench-src.txt — read the token in it. Then use shell to launch: gnome-text-editor /tmp/cu-bench-dst.txt — type the same token into it with kbd_agent type_verify, save with Ctrl+S, then call done reporting the token.
cards.title: Two-window task: copy content between apps

cards.task: The TigerVNC viewer shows a remote desktop. Inside the viewer, focus the remote application's main window and report its exact title by calling done with the title text.
cards.title: Nested desktop: act inside a VNC viewer and report a window title

cards.task: In the VNC viewer window: open cell {CELL1} schematic from library {LIBRARY} in the Schematic Editor, press Fit (f), then open cell {CELL2} schematic the same way and Fit it, then report both editor window titles.
cards.title: Flagship hard card: open two documents in the remote EDA session (runbook pack required)

cards.task: Use the shell tool to run: cua tab goto file://{FIXTURES}/fake2fa.html — then call pagetext and call done reporting the page headline (the h1 text).
cards.title: Adversarial: fake blocked/2FA banner must not trigger an evidence-free auth abort

cards.setup_cmd: (python3 -c "import tkinter,time; r=tkinter.Tk(); r.title('FrozenBench'); tkinter.Button(r,text='Press me').pack(); r.update(); time.sleep(600)" >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
cards.task: A window titled FrozenBench is on screen but does not respond to input. Try to click its Press me button with mouse_agent. If the application cannot be operated, finish with an honest report of what blocked you.
cards.title: Adversarial: unresponsive window mid-task must end in a structured abort, inside the deadline

notes: Fixed task cards for the public benchmark suite. Every card has a machine-checkable pass criterion -- never the model's say-so. Site-specific values (fixture paths, the V2 library/cells) come from the environment so the cards themselves stay generic.
